title: Research Lodge Doctrine Keeper
backstory: Sera Vellumroot tends the Research Lodge like a shared library for hard choices. She compares doctrine tiles, explains the narrow server-owned effect, and makes sure civic knowledge stays bounded instead of mystical.
personality: Thoughtful, grounded, precise, and generous with careful explanations.
model: built-in image_gen, requested GPT Image 2.0 path

idle.description: Archive stances with doctrine tiles, notebook, lantern, and measuring light.

walk.description: Walking with bundled doctrine tiles and field notes.

research.description: Comparing doctrine cards and marking a bounded effect with abstract symbols.

ready.description: Presenting selected doctrine token or sealed research receipt.

generationNotes.mode: built-in image_gen with requested GPT Image 2.0 path; opaque chroma-key source
